text:
Type: artificial potted orchid
Use: lasting decoration on a table, a desk, a shelf or a windowsill; living room, home office, bedroom
Style: contemporary, Scandinavian, minimalist
Materials: artificial plastic flowers and leaves, green stem on a support stake, dark grey plastic pot
Colors: soft pink flowers, fresh green leaves, dark charcoal grey
Shape: single tall arching flower stem with a cluster of pink blooms and buds, broad glossy leaves at the base, small round pot, slender and upright
Feel: fresh, delicate, elegant, easy
Goes with: white surfaces, light wood, ceramic cachepots, pastel tones; Scandinavian, minimalist or contemporary rooms

product.name: FEJKA
product.description: Lifelike artificial plant that remain just as fresh-looking year after year.
